newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise in most maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise in most maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in most maturities on Wednesday in line with the trend in the money market, traders said on Wednesday.
"A lot of banks have been swapping their dollars to get peso liquidity," a foreign bank dealer said.
Tight liquidity in the money market prodded banks to raise swap rates for the one-week to three-month maturities, dealers said.
But the six-month and one-year rates were steady to lower because these were not always vulnerable to the daily changes in money market rates, they added.
